scenarios.name: Change a main-panel command button size

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
"Shell" is a standard-sized button in the 3D Model "Modify" main panel
the user right-clicks "Shell" and opens "Button Size"
"Shell" is displayed with a larger icon and its label below
the other commands in the panel reflow
the user right-clicks "Shell" and opens "Button Size"
"Shell" returns to a small icon with its label beside it
